Across the opening five PL fixtures, 450 minutes, Bruno covered almost identical distance:

Hull: 5 sprints | 30.5km/h l 0.07km sprint distance 
Ipswich: 18 sprints | 32.4km/h l 0.33km sprint distance
Everton: 11 sprints l 29.6km/h l 0.22km sprint distance
